lines.en: Mia, you look so much stronger! If you hadn’t joined the gym last spring, would you have felt this good?
lines.pt: Mia, você parece muito mais forte! Se você não tivesse entrado na academia na primavera passada, se sentiria tão bem?

lines.en: Honestly, no. If I hadn’t exercised, I’d have felt worse, and my back pain would have got much worse.
lines.pt: Sinceramente, não. Se eu não tivesse me exercitado, eu me sentiria pior e a dor nas costas teria piorado muito.

lines.en: I remember how you struggled in the first month. If you had given up then, you wouldn’t have noticed any progress.
lines.pt: Lembro como você sofreu no primeiro mês. Se tivesse desistido então, não teria notado nenhum progresso.

lines.en: True. If you hadn’t encouraged me, I would have quit after two weeks. You pushed me to keep going.
lines.pt: Verdade. Se você não tivesse me incentivado, eu teria largado depois de duas semanas. Você me empurrou a continuar.

lines.en: And if you hadn’t changed your diet, your cholesterol wouldn’t have improved so quickly. The doctor was impressed.
lines.pt: E se você não tivesse mudado a dieta, seu colesterol não teria melhorado tão rápido. O médico ficou impressionado.

lines.en: He said I might have developed diabetes if I had carried on eating the way I did before.
lines.pt: Ele disse que eu poderia ter desenvolvido diabetes se tivesse continuado a comer como antes.

lines.en: That’s scary. If I had known that, I would have talked to you much sooner about your habits.
lines.pt: Isso assusta. Se eu soubesse disso, teria conversado com você muito antes sobre os seus hábitos.

lines.en: Don’t feel guilty. If you had said something sooner, I probably wouldn’t have listened. I had to be ready.
lines.pt: Não se sinta culpado. Se você tivesse dito algo antes, eu provavelmente não teria escutado. Eu precisava estar pronta.

lines.en: Fair point. What would you have done if the gym had been too expensive?
lines.pt: Justo. O que você teria feito se a academia fosse cara demais?

lines.en: I’d have gone running in the park. If it hadn’t rained so much, I might have started even sooner.
lines.pt: Teria ido correr no parque. Se não tivesse chovido tanto, talvez eu tivesse começado ainda mais cedo.

lines.en: Well, I’m proud of you. If you hadn’t made this effort, you wouldn’t be running that half marathon in June.
lines.pt: Bem, estou orgulhoso de você. Se você não tivesse feito esse esforço, não estaria correndo aquela meia maratona em junho.

facts.big: if + had + particípio, would have + particípio
facts.label: 3º condicional
facts.sub: Passado irreal: If I hadn’t exercised, I’d have felt worse. Nunca use would no if-clause.

facts.label: Se eu tivesse
facts.sub: Forme a condição com if + had + particípio: If I had trained… Fala de algo que não aconteceu no passado. Em português: “se eu tivesse treinado”. Para o negativo, use hadn’t + particípio.

facts.label: Teria feito
facts.sub: O resultado usa would have + particípio: …I would have felt better. Em português: “teria me sentido melhor”. Na fala vira I’d have felt. Não use would no if-clause.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: If I had known, I would have told you refers to the past.
The if-clause uses the past perfect.
We say “If I would have known”.
items.why: We say If I had known.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: If I had known, I would have told you refers to the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
The if-clause uses the past perfect. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If I would have known”. → Falso (We say If I had known.)

pages.title: Stronger than before · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a Saturday morning in Liverpool. Luisa is finishing her workout at the gym. Her friend Dean works there as a trainer. She started training last spring. Now she feels healthier than ever. They sit down for some water.

“Luisa, you look so much stronger! If you hadn’t joined the gym last spring, would you have felt this good?” says Dean. “Honestly, no. If I hadn’t exercised, I’d have felt worse, and my back pain would have got much worse.” says Luisa. “I remember how you struggled in the first month. If you had given up then, you wouldn’t have noticed any progress.” says Dean.
